visual_logic: Highlights the expanded, spoon-like circular expansion at the tip of the Ornithocheirus jaw with outward-radiating teeth.
prompt: High-fidelity 3D asset of the terminal tip of an Ornithocheirus jaw, showcase-focused on its 'Spoon-Tipped' morphology, rendered in a 3D animated feature film aesthetic with soft, stylized edges. The very tip of the narrow jaw flares outward into a distinct, circular, spoon-shaped rosette profile, packed with thick, vertically robust ivory fangs that splay aggressively outward in a fan-like array. The enamel texture is smooth, polished, and detailed with crisp vertical growth striations. The specimen is oriented vertically and perfectly centered in a 1:1 square composition, carefully scaled to occupy the central power-zone, keeping a strict 25% negative space safety margin on all four sides. Placed flat against a neutral, 50% grey studio floor plane with high-contrast contact shadows. Illuminated by soft studio lighting with ambient occlusion to beautifully sculpt the rounded spoon expansion and radiating tooth placement.
